# Mockey AI

> > Free AI-powered mockup generator with 20,000+ templates for apparel, packaging, tech devices, and print materials.

Mockey AI is a comprehensive mockup design platform offering thousands of customizable templates across multiple product categories. Users can create professional product visualizations for e-commerce, branding, and print-on-demand businesses without watermarks.
